title: Grabbed by the Ghoulies (USA) (En,Fr,De,Es,It).xiso.iso

arms.A: 709cfb13aa (master 94394f1062 + [tlb68] counters; both #311 defines 0, RD/JC env off)

legs.M0 (instrument): Every arm prints a [tlb68] line in >= 90% of its 2 s windows from 20 s on. A run without them is VOID, not zero.
legs.M1 (model, arm A): ghoul311's model (#311 comment 5839584187): in A, tw/rdc (entries walked per arming walk) at ~120 s is >= 8x its ~20 s value, and tn at 120 s is >= 8x tn at 20 s, while gfps falls. REFUTED if tw/rdc stays within 2x of its 20 s value while gfps collapses: then the walk's unit cost is not what grows.
legs.Ma (must-move, hunk a): Ba: median gfps over 90-240 s >= 25. And rdc (arming walks per window) in Ba is <= 10% of A's over the same span, with kafb <= 0.1 * ka. FAILS if gfps < 25; if rdc fell and gfps did not rise, the arming walk is not the collapse.
legs.Mb (must-move, hunk b): Bb: median gfps over 90-240 s >= 25, tn <= 8192 at every line, and tw/rdc at 120 s within 2x of its 20 s value. FAILS if gfps < 25 with tn capped: the walk's size is not the collapse.
legs.Rival: Nothing in either patch forces its gfps leg true: (a) only removes the re-arm walk and (b) only caps its size. If both fail, the model (the arming walk grows into the frame) is refuted, and the collapse lies elsewhere (ghoul311's bisect decides).

must_not_move: pgraph must-not-move per hunk: tcgchurn-311a-pixels-inert.json, tcgchurn-311b-pixels-inert.json (8 suites, identical captures)
Crimson Skies and JSRF 240 s soaks on each hunk's ref: no crash, no hang (frames still counted at 240 s), no tombstone in logcat -b crash
the refs differ from 709cfb13aa by exactly one #define line in include/accel/tcg/hakux-tlb68.h
expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures, so there is no golden key for ab_compare to judge. The legs are read by hand off the gfps and [tlb68] lines; the content hash recorded at queue time is what makes a widened leg detectable.
